parent_objective: audit source-budgeted task-source specs before any rollout design
blocked_by: M1680 specs must be audited before environment rollout design because metadata-role share and unspecified-window share are near/caveated

public_gates: M1681 must audit M1680 summary specs and source_budget_summary
M1681 must verify hidden/action target leakage remains zero
M1681 must audit metadata-role and unspecified-window caveats
M1681 must choose rollout design, source-budget repair, or explicit-window subset route
M1681 must keep private holdout promotion actor-input changes paper-level claims and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use M1615 hidden tensors or actions as benchmark targets

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits no-training task-source specs before rollout design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1680 artifacts are missing
stop if hidden/action target leakage is nonzero
stop if near-cap metadata-role or unspecified-window caveats are ignored
stop if audit routes directly to private holdout or paper evidence
fallback_plan: route to bounded rollout design if audit passes
route to source-budget repair if metadata-role cap is too fragile
route to explicit-window subset design if unspecified-window share is unacceptable
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1680 materializes no-training task-source specs and requires audit before rollout design

admission_evidence: M1680 reports 72 specs, T4/T5 36/36, 12 source families, 15 source edges, 4 window tags, all caps pass, zero leakage and zero guardrail violations
allowed_updates: M1681 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for rollout design or repair route
next_stage_criteria: cap and caveat status is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; audit must preserve future L1, L2-current-tiled, and L3-reset controls.
history_necessity_tests: audit must not claim history necessity from specs
audit must require future rollout design to evaluate current-substitution controls
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If spec caveats block rollout design, record source-budget limitation and repair before rollout.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1680's no-training task-source specs are clean enough to admit bounded rollout-design planning, subject to auditing the near metadata-role cap and unspecified-window caveat.
success_criteria: M1680 summary specs and source_budget_summary are audited
leakage cap and caveat status are explicit
next rollout-design or repair route is explicit
environment rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: M1680 leakage or cap status is not checked
metadata-role or unspecified-window caveats are omitted
audit routes directly to rollout execution private holdout promotion or paper evidence
audit claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID
decision_rule: M1681 passes if it audits M1680 and admits only bounded rollout-design planning or repair.
